---
title: "Massacres of the Guatemalan Civil War"
page-layout: full
description: "An interactive map of massacres documented by the REMHI project, 1970–1995."
---

The 530 massacres documented in the **REMHI** database (*Recuperación de la
Memoria Histórica* — "Guatemala: Nunca Más", ODHAG 1998), built from 5,397
witness testimonies. Click a department, then a municipality, to reach
individual sites — each with its date, the range of death tolls witnesses
reported, the named victims, the responsible force and REMHI's narrative.
Press **Play years** to watch the violence move across the country.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About the data and its limits

REMHI recorded what witnesses told Catholic-church interviewers in the
mid-1990s. It is **not** a census of massacres: regions with a weaker church
presence are underrepresented, and the death tolls are witness reports rather
than verified counts, so the map shows the median of what witnesses said
alongside the full range they gave.

Coordinates are not in the source database — they were matched from place
names against the GeoNames gazetteer. Every record carries a precision flag,
and events that could only be located to a municipality are listed rather than
drawn as points, so nothing on the map claims more precision than the
testimony supports. 82 of the 530 massacres have no year recorded and are
excluded while a single year is selected.

Source: REMHI / ODHAG, *Guatemala: Nunca Más* (1998),
[remhi.org.gt/bd](https://www.remhi.org.gt/bd/).
:::

```{=html}
<iframe id="gt-map"
        src="guatemala-map/index.html"
        title="Interactive map of massacres of the Guatemalan civil war"
        loading="lazy"
        style="width:100%; height:calc(100vh - 190px); min-height:620px;
               border:1px solid var(--bs-border-color); border-radius:8px;">
</iframe>

<script>
// Keep the embedded map in step with the site's light/dark toggle. Quarto
// stamps `quarto-dark` / `quarto-light` on <body>; the map accepts a
// {theme:'dark'|'light'} message and re-themes itself (ramp, basemap tiles
// and all). Without this the iframe would follow the OS setting instead of
// the visitor's choice on this site.
(function () {
  var frame = document.getElementById('gt-map');
  if (!frame) return;
  var target = location.origin && location.origin !== 'null' ? location.origin : '*';
  function push() {
    if (!frame.contentWindow) return;
    var theme = document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark') ? 'dark' : 'light';
    frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ theme: theme }, target);
  }
  frame.addEventListener('load', push);
  new MutationObserver(push).observe(document.body,
    { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
})();
</script>
```
